lead.titleZh: 偏瘫足底知觉学习与乳腺癌术后腋网综合征物理治疗，2 篇高分文献
lead.titleEn: Plantar Perceptual Learning in Hemiplegia and Axillary Web Syndrome PT Post-Breast Cancer Surgery: Two High-Score Papers
lead.paragraphZh: 今日共 11 篇条目，涵盖 4 个专业方向，其中骨科与肌骨和神经康复各占 4 篇。最高分 85 分的条目有 2 篇，分别为：一篇 RCT 关注偏瘫患者足底知觉学习对跌倒风险及肌肉扭矩的影响，以及一篇系统综述比较乳腺癌术后腋网综合征不同物理疗法的有效性，这两篇都是今天临床工作者最值得关注的证据。
lead.paragraphEn: Today's 11 entries span 4 specialties, with 4 each in Orthopedics & Musculoskeletal and Neurological Rehabilitation. Two entries scored 85, our highest today: one RCT on perceptual learning in plantar hardness discrimination for hemiplegia affecting fall risk and muscle torque, and one systematic review comparing physical therapies for axillary web syndrome post-breast cancer surgery. These two represent the most impactful evidence for clinicians today.

items.title: Effect of Incorporating Perceptual Learning Into Plantar Hardness Discrimination on the Risk of Falling and Muscle Torque in Patients With Hemiplegia: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=34) found that incorporating perceptual learning into plantar hardness discrimination significantly reduced fall risk (P <0.001, ES=1.48), increased knee extensors torque (P <0.001, ES=1.19), and improved FIM scores (P <0.001, ES=1.56) in hemiplegic stroke patients compared to a control group.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 表明，在偏瘫患者的康复方案中加入足底硬度辨别知觉学习，能显著降低跌倒风险、增强膝伸肌扭矩并改善功能独立性。这为你优化卒中康复训练提供了明确的循证依据，尤其是在平衡和下肢力量方面。
items.titleZh: 偏瘫患者足底硬度辨别知觉学习对跌倒风险和肌肉扭矩影响的随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=34）发现，在偏瘫患者的康复方案中加入足底硬度辨别知觉学习，与对照组相比，显著降低了跌倒风险（P <0.001, ES=1.48）、增加了膝伸肌扭矩（P <0.001, ES=1.19），并改善了 FIM 评分（P <0.001, ES=1.56）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT indicates that incorporating perceptual learning with plantar hardness discrimination into rehabilitation programs for hemiplegic patients significantly reduces fall risk, enhances knee extensor torque, and improves functional independence. This provides clear evidence to optimize stroke rehabilitation, particularly regarding balance and lower limb strength.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（34 例），且随访期短，结果的长期稳定性和普适性需更多研究验证。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (34 patients) and short follow-up, so long-term stability and generalizability of results require further validation.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Comparative effectiveness of different physical therapies for axillary web syndrome after breast cancer surgery: A network meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
items.summary: A network meta-analysis of 14 RCTs (1007 patients) found that soft tissue manual therapy + therapeutic exercise + low-level laser therapy significantly reduced pain (SMD = -4.40) and improved shoulder abduction (MD = 59.51) and flexion (MD = 77.30) in axillary web syndrome, while MLD + therapeutic exercise showed the largest improvement in upper-limb disability (MD = -19.01).
items.curatedReason: 这项网络荟萃分析为乳腺癌术后腋网综合征（AWS）的物理治疗提供了比较有效性证据。软组织手法治疗 + 治疗性运动 + 低能量激光疗法在改善疼痛和肩关节活动度方面表现最佳，而手法淋巴引流 + 治疗性运动在改善上肢功能障碍方面效果显著。在为 AWS 患者设计综合康复方案时，可优先考虑这些组合。
items.titleZh: 乳腺癌术后腋网综合征不同物理疗法的比较有效性：随机对照试验的网络荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 14 项随机对照试验（1007 例患者）的网络荟萃分析发现，软组织手法治疗 + 治疗性运动 + 低能量激光疗法显著减轻了腋网综合征的疼痛（SMD = -4.40）并改善了肩关节外展（MD = 59.51）和屈曲（MD = 77.30），而手法淋巴引流 + 治疗性运动对上肢功能障碍的改善最大（MD = -19.01）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This network meta-analysis provides comparative effectiveness evidence for physical therapies in axillary web syndrome (AWS) after breast cancer surgery. Soft tissue manual therapy + therapeutic exercise + low-level laser therapy showed the best improvement in pain and shoulder ROM, while manual lymphatic drainage + therapeutic exercise significantly improved upper-limb disability. Prioritize these combinations when designing comprehensive rehabilitation for AWS patients.
items.limitation: 研究网络稀疏（11 种干预/14 项研究），存在临床异质性，且固定效应模型与随机效应模型结果在某些结局上存在差异，限制了证据的确定性。
items.limitationEn: The sparse network (11 interventions/14 studies), clinical heterogeneity, and model-dependent results (some CrIs crossing null in random-effects analysis) limit the certainty of the evidence.

items.title: Interprofessional communication and early rehabilitation practices in orthopaedic surgery: a cross-sectional survey
items.summary: A cross-sectional survey of 84 orthopedic surgeons and 513 physiotherapists in Türkiye revealed that despite 96.4% of surgeons acknowledging the importance of early physiotherapy, only 27.4% reported initiation within 0-3 postoperative days, and nearly half of both groups reported low direct communication.
items.curatedReason: 尽管骨科医生和物理治疗师都认识到早期康复的重要性，但本研究揭示了土耳其在术后康复启动时间及医患沟通实践上的显著差异，提示行业在标准化流程和跨专业协作上仍有待改进。
items.titleZh: 骨科手术中的跨专业沟通与早期康复实践：一项横断面调查
items.summaryZh: 一项针对土耳其 84 名骨科医生和 513 名物理治疗师的横断面调查显示，尽管 96.4% 的外科医生认识到早期物理治疗的重要性，但只有 27.4% 的人报告在术后 0-3 天内开始康复，且近半数受访者表示直接沟通不足。
items.curatedReasonEn: Despite awareness of early rehabilitation's importance, this study highlights significant variations in post-operative rehabilitation timing and interprofessional communication practices in Türkiye, suggesting a need for improved standardization and collaboration.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面调查，只能揭示相关性而非因果关系，且可能存在回忆偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional survey, which can only show correlations, not causation, and may be subject to recall bias.

items.title: Predicting Robot-Based Tracking Performance After Stroke Using Lesion Features and Clinical Assessments: A Pilot Study
items.summary: A pilot study (n=18) found clinical assessments significantly predicted robot-based tracking error (R^2=0.45) in chronic stroke patients, outperforming lesion features. Attention- and motor-related measures were identified as the strongest predictors.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步研究表明，临床评估在预测卒中后机器人辅助追踪表现方面优于单纯的病灶特征。临床PT可继续关注患者的运动和认知功能，将其作为康复预后的关键指标，并期待未来更大样本的研究提供更精确的影像预测价值。
items.titleZh: 基于病灶特征和临床评估预测卒中后机器人辅助追踪表现：一项初步研究
items.summaryZh: 一项初步研究（n=18）发现，在慢性卒中患者中，临床评估显著预测机器人辅助追踪误差（R^2=0.45），优于单纯的病灶特征。注意力与运动相关指标被确定为最强预测因子。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot study suggests that clinical assessments are superior to lesion features alone in predicting robot-based tracking performance after stroke. Clinical PTs should continue to prioritize motor and cognitive functional assessments as key indicators for rehabilitation prognosis, while awaiting larger studies for more precise imaging predictive value.
items.limitation: 本研究为小样本（n=18）探索性试点研究，且关注的是机器人辅助追踪表现的替代终点，其结果外推至真实世界功能性康复效果需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: This was a small-sample (n=18) exploratory pilot study focusing on a surrogate endpoint of robot-based tracking performance; therefore, generalizing these results to real-world functional rehabilitation outcomes should be done with caution.

items.title: Implementing low-cost Capability, Opportunity Motivation and Behaviour (COM-B) interventions to increase bed-substitution rehabilitation referrals in acute stroke care.
items.summary: Low-cost COM-B interventions increased bed-substitution rehabilitation referrals in acute stroke care from 5.6% to 9.6% (p = 0.002) over 12 months in a study of 1146 patients (median age 65, 53% male).
items.curatedReason: 这项实施研究成功地通过COM-B模型干预将急性卒中患者的床位替代康复转诊率从5.6%提高到9.6% (p = 0.002)。这为你改进康复转诊流程提供了实际案例和数据支持。
items.titleZh: 在急性卒中护理中实施低成本能力、机会、动机和行为（COM-B）干预措施以增加床位替代康复转诊
items.summaryZh: 一项对1146名患者（中位年龄65岁，53%男性）的研究显示，低成本COM-B干预措施在12个月内将急性卒中护理中床位替代康复转诊率从5.6%提高到9.6% (p = 0.002)。
items.curatedReasonEn: This implementation study successfully increased bed-substitution rehabilitation referrals for acute stroke patients from 5.6% to 9.6% (p = 0.002) using COM-B model interventions. This offers practical insights and data to improve your rehabilitation referral processes.
items.limitation: 单一中心的实施研究，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-center implementation study, limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: The effects of stretching interventions in people with multiple sclerosis: a systematic review.
items.summary: A systematic review of 7 studies (144 participants, 44.5 ± 9.6 years) found descriptively favorable changes after stretching in PwMS, with some outcomes (Timed Up and Go, flexibility, spasticity, pain, fatigue) meeting minimal important change, but evidence certainty was very low (GRADE).
items.curatedReason: 尽管证据确定性仍为“非常低”，但该系统综述提示拉伸干预可能改善多发性硬化症（MS）患者的活动能力、痉挛、疼痛和疲劳。在制定综合康复策略时，你可以考虑将其作为辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 拉伸干预对多发性硬化症患者的影响：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对7项研究（144名参与者，44.5 ± 9.6岁）的系统综述发现，多发性硬化症患者在拉伸后出现描述性有利变化，部分结局（计时起立行走、柔韧性、痉挛、疼痛、疲劳）达到最小临床重要改变，但证据确定性非常低（GRADE）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Although the certainty of evidence remains "very low," this systematic review suggests that stretching interventions may improve mobility, spasticity, pain, and fatigue in people with multiple sclerosis (MS). You can consider incorporating it as an adjunct in comprehensive rehabilitation strategies.
items.limitation: 纳入研究数量少（7项，144名参与者），且拉伸常作为对照而非主要干预，导致证据确定性非常低。
items.limitationEn: The review included a small number of studies (7 studies, 144 participants), and stretching was often an active comparator or control, leading to very low certainty of evidence.

items.title: Stage-Dependent Sarcopenia Status in Parkinson's Disease: An ICF-Based ISarcoPRM Algorithm.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study (n=63) using the ICF-based ISarcoPRM algorithm found sarcopenia prevalence differed significantly across groups (P=0.016), with muscle-related impairments being stage-dependent and more pronounced in moderate-stage Parkinson's disease compared to early-stage PD and healthy controls.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究利用 ICF-based ISarcoPRM 算法评估了帕金森病患者肌少症的阶段性状态。它提示肌少症在帕金森病中是阶段依赖性的，在中度阶段更为显著，这支持了早期识别和针对性干预的重要性。你在评估帕金森病患者时，应综合考虑肌肉形态、力量和体能表现，以便更精准地制定康复策略。
items.titleZh: 帕金森病肌少症的阶段依赖性状态：基于 ICF 的 ISarcoPRM 算法
items.summaryZh: 一项使用 ICF-based ISarcoPRM 算法的横断面研究（n=63）发现，帕金森病患者肌少症的患病率在不同组间存在显著差异（P=0.016），肌肉相关损害呈阶段依赖性，在中度帕金森病阶段比早期和健康对照组更为显著。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study used the ICF-based ISarcoPRM algorithm to assess stage-dependent sarcopenia in Parkinson's disease, suggesting it becomes more pronounced in moderate stages. This supports the importance of early identification and targeted interventions. When evaluating PD patients, you should integrate muscle morphology, strength, and physical performance for more precise rehabilitation strategies.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法建立因果关系，且样本量相对较小（n=63），结果的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This was a cross-sectional study, preventing the establishment of causality, and the relatively small sample size (n=63) limits the generalizability of the findings.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Robotic Assessment of Thumb Proprioception after Stroke: Reliability, Validity, and Sensitivity
items.summary: A study evaluated the reliability, validity, and sensitivity of SomatoCircleJump, a novel robotic assessment for thumb proprioception, in individuals with chronic stroke.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究评估了新的机器人评估工具 SomatoCircleJump 在卒中后拇指本体感觉障碍中的可靠性、有效性和敏感性。如果你在神经康复中评估上肢本体感觉，这是一个值得关注的工具进展。
items.titleZh: 卒中后拇指本体感觉的机器人评估：可靠性、有效性和敏感性
items.summaryZh: 一项研究评估了SomatoCircleJump这一新型机器人评估工具在慢性卒中患者拇指本体感觉中的可靠性、有效性和敏感性。
items.curatedReasonEn: For thumb proprioception assessment post-stroke, the SomatoCircleJump robotic system shows preliminary reliability, validity, and sensitivity. If you're seeking more precise, standardized assessment tools, this observational study suggests its future potential in neurorehabilitation is worth noting.
items.limitation: 研究对象仅限于慢性卒中患者，结果不一定能外推到急性期或亚急性期卒中患者。
items.limitationEn: The study included only individuals with chronic stroke, and the results may not be generalizable to acute or subacute stroke patients.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Cardiorespiratory training after stroke or transient ischemic attack in the United Kingdom: A national survey.
items.summary: A national survey (n=253) of UK physiotherapists and exercise professionals found varying provision of cardiorespiratory training after stroke or TIA, with people with greater disability potentially less likely to receive it. Key concerns included serious adverse events, fatigue, falls, and barriers such as commissioning, resources, skills, and lack of guidelines.
items.curatedReason: 这项英国全国调查揭示了卒中和短暂性脑缺血发作（TIA）后心肺训练的现状、风险认知和实施障碍。它突出显示了服务提供不均（残疾程度较高者可能更难获得训练）、对风险因素认知不一以及指南缺乏等问题。这提示你，在临床实践中推广和实施心肺训练仍面临挑战，需关注服务公平性和专业知识培训。
items.titleZh: 英国卒中或短暂性脑缺血发作后心肺训练的全国调查
items.summaryZh: 一项针对英国物理治疗师和运动专业人士的全国调查（n=253）发现，卒中或短暂性脑缺血发作后心肺训练的提供情况各异，残疾程度较高者可能更难获得训练。主要担忧包括严重不良事件、疲劳、跌倒，以及服务委托、资源、技能和指南缺乏等障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: This UK national survey reveals the current provision, risk perceptions, and barriers to cardiorespiratory training after stroke and TIA. It highlights disparities in service delivery (individuals with greater disability potentially less likely to receive training), inconsistent risk factor perceptions, and a lack of guidelines. This suggests that implementing and promoting cardiorespiratory training in clinical practice still faces challenges, requiring attention to service equity and professional knowledge training.

items.title: How ChoosePT Turns PTs' Expertise Into Trusted Public Resources
items.summary: APTA's ChoosePT.com serves as a consumer-focused resource providing free, reliable, evidence-based health information on physical therapy, with content reviewed by board-certified specialists like Anna V. Howard, PT, BS, PCS, a pediatric clinical specialist.
items.curatedReason: 在向患者家庭解释儿童物理治疗时，你可以直接引用 APTA 的 ChoosePT.com。这个网站内容经过专家评审，能为家长提供可靠的循证信息，省去了你自行寻找科普素材的时间。
items.titleZh: ChoosePT 如何将物理治疗师的专业知识转化为值得信赖的公共资源
items.summaryZh: APTA 的 ChoosePT.com 网站是一个面向大众的资源平台，提供免费、可靠、循证的物理治疗健康信息，其内容由 Anna V. Howard 博士等经专业认证的儿科临床专家负责评审。
items.curatedReasonEn: When explaining pediatric physical therapy to patient families, direct them to APTA's ChoosePT.com. The expert-reviewed, evidence-based content will save you time in finding reliable educational materials for parents.

items.title: Live Billing Q&A: Answering Your Compliance Questions Recap
items.summary: WebPT published a recap of its live billing Q&A session, summarizing compliance questions and answers for physical therapy practices.
items.curatedReason: WebPT 发布了其关于计费合规性问答的总结，这类回顾性内容对于想巩固计费知识或错过直播的诊所管理者和PT来说，可以作为查漏补缺的参考。
items.titleZh: 2026 年 10 月 29 日直播计费问答：您的合规性问题回顾
items.summaryZh: WebPT 发布了其计费合规性直播问答环节的回顾，总结了物理治疗诊所的合规性问题及答案。
items.curatedReasonEn: WebPT released a recap of their billing compliance Q&A. This type of retrospective content can serve as a useful reference for clinic managers and PTs looking to reinforce their billing knowledge or catch up on missed live sessions.
